t: You're looking at St Dionis, an Anglican church at Parsons Green in Fulham. It's Grade II listed, which means it's recognised as a building of special interest. Buried here is Sir Edward Osborne, who lived from around 1530 to 1591. He was one of the principal merchants of London in the later sixteenth century, and he served as Lord Mayor of London in 1583. That's the link between this quiet Fulham church and the City's commercial and civic life.
